title: Passivity Enforcement
text: Modify control actions to satisfy passivity constraints and action bounds, 6 inputs, 2 outputs, {Passivity index} sets Passivity index; {Number of actions} sets the number of control actions, {Use external source for upper bound} adds upper action bound input port, {Use external source for lower bound} adds lower action bound input port, {Sample time} sets the optimization sample time, {Maximum iterations} sets the maximum optimization iterations, {Constraint tolerance} sets the tolerance for constraint and {Optimization status} adds exit flag output port. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: fp
ports.summary: Passivity input function offset coefficient scalar | vector

ports.name: gp
ports.summary: Passivity input function linear coefficient scalar | matrix

ports.name: umax
ports.summary: Action signal upper bounds scalar | vector

ports.name: umin
ports.summary: Action signal lower bounds scalar | vector

params.name: Number of actions
params.values: Number of control actions 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Passivity index
params.values: Passivity index 0.1 (default) | nonnegative scalar | nonnegative vector

params.name: Use external source for upper bound
params.values: Add upper action bound input port off (default) | on

params.name: Use external source for lower bound
params.values: Add lower action bound input port off (default) | on

params.name: Constraint tolerance
params.values: Tolerance for constraint violations 1e-6 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Optimization status
params.values: Add exit flag output port off (default) | on
